title: Dual-Cloud Concept Cover & Residual Preservation (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `cover_leftover` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Uses two explicit learned particle clouds to test whether adversarial updates match both concept poles (pole_rel_err <= 0.20) while preserving orthogonal residual content (content_kept >= 0.75) with low leakage (leak_ratio <= 0.20).
failure_mode: Adversarial forces collapse the residual content subspace onto the concept axis or cross-contaminate the positive and negative clouds.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `cover_leftover` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
